fixes.title: One speech owner; defer radio and lore
fixes.proposal: Share a priority queue across assistant, radio and boss. Do not layer intelligible speech; cancel stale positive commentary at damage/death. Defer lore and codex announcements rather than adding louder alerts.
fixes.why: C's audio-only pass independently confirms masking; combined audio-source scores are 1–2/5. A's assistant interrupts itself twice within four seconds.

fixes.title: Protect survival information from peripheral UI
fixes.proposal: Move the persistent install/offline affordance away from hull information during a run. Keep one urgent threat/damage cue and a plainly readable remaining-lives state; remove unnecessary HUD motion while damage is being resolved.
fixes.why: E records 3→2→1→0 lives, yet observers infer one-hit or unclear death. The install control overlaps the top-right HUD region.

fixes.title: One action confirmation, tied to its actual target
fixes.proposal: Replace competing lock/intel/disarm/codex notices with one short confirmation attached to the affected target, then a stable state change. On the boss, make existing pod loss/core-open states distinguishable before adding any effects. Do not replace correct event triggers with timers.
fixes.why: All three passes miss Writ-caused pod loss at D 10.05/16.67 s; one wrongly recommends fixing a timer that is not the cause. C lock-to-clean-kill lasts about 0.18 s.

fixes.title: Consolidate readable text; postpone nonurgent reading
fixes.proposal: Use one active reading zone for speech, preserve word spacing, enlarge essential target states or remove their prose during dodging. File codex/lore silently for a safe reading moment. Stack the hangar inspector in narrow layouts rather than hiding it off-screen.
fixes.why: Combat splits reading across bottom subtitles, left radio, top codex and moving labels. F's calm menu reads well, while H loses the inspector and key legend despite readable list text.

fixes.title: Replace tutorial narration-only state with an actionable prompt
fixes.proposal: Show the currently resolved binding and a concise current-step state, including release then press when freshness matters. Keep the correction explicitly text-only if no VO exists. Reduce player bloom while teaching the existing hitbox instead of adding glow.
fixes.why: G's long-held focus does not satisfy the fresh-input gate until release/repress, but picture-only cannot verify this. Two combined passes invent audio for a silent corrective subtitle.

rows.ground_truth: Enemy gun partBreak and disarm by Writ at 0.737 s; same enemy killed at 1.289 s. Assistant disarm audio starts 1.52 s, then lock audio replaces it at 3.00 s.
rows.accounts: All three notice a disarm/destroy response but explicitly cannot distinguish the cause or specific part. Threat detection remains 4–5/5.
rows.confusion: Destruction, part break and disarm collapse into a generic hit. Short voice replacement does not finish the explanation.
rows.minimal_fix: One target-linked action confirmation; drop or queue redundant speech.

rows.ground_truth: scanLock/intel at 3.128 s, another lock at 4.776 s, clean kill of first target also sampled at 4.776 s. Assistant lock audio starts 3.00 s and graze audio 5.24 s.
rows.accounts: Novice reads lock/intel; information critic calls out tiny PATROL and uncertain disarm. Causality critic links cone to lock but cannot identify the weapon.
rows.confusion: Good coarse detection does not establish the input→lock→charged-action chain.
rows.minimal_fix: Reserve one action-confirmation slot and retain a short stable target state; defer codex toast.

rows.ground_truth: Dense combat includes repeated graze/pay/charge changes, target labels, radio and bottom subtitles. Source captures and all three accounts identify concurrent assistant/radio speech near 27 s.
rows.accounts: All three describe bullet origins. All three identify speech competition; audio-source ratings are 3/2/3. They disagree about the exact time and ownership of the clearing wave.
rows.confusion: Threats are detectable, but the cause of the defensive clearing action and meaning of pay changes remain uncertain under commentary.
rows.minimal_fix: Exclusive speech ownership; suppress optional radio/toast activity during the action confirmation.

rows.ground_truth: scanLock on dart at 11.744 s; clean kill at 11.928 s. Radio dart-loss audio starts 10.39 s; assistant lock audio starts 11.74 s. Codex and world-space state are visible around the transition.
rows.accounts: Observers identify a scan but cannot specify its trigger; picture-only cannot relate the cone to normal fire. Audio-only hears interrupted dart speech and then lock commentary.
rows.confusion: About 0.18 s separates sampled lock and kill. Competing reading and voices occupy the causal transition.
rows.minimal_fix: Keep a stable lock-to-result confirmation and defer codex/lore; do not add another flash.

rows.ground_truth: Lane Control source starts 17.96 s (6.96 s buffer); assistant amb_fight_005 starts 20.14 s (5.92 s buffer). Capture includes both voices over active combat, radio text, subtitles and changing HUD.
rows.accounts: Novice/information/causality audio-source ratings 2/1/2. Audio-only independently reports masking at 20.5–25.8 s, without seeing any subtitle.
rows.confusion: This is verified speech interference, not merely a judge reading subtitles or a preference about mix beauty.
rows.minimal_fix: One main speech owner with deferred radio; preserve threat and action cues beneath it.

rows.ground_truth: Writ breaks left boss fan pod at 10.050 s, right fan pod at 16.672 s; coreExposed also at 16.672 s. Score stays zero. Warden pod VO starts 9.91 s.
rows.accounts: All three say the player is not firing and fail to explain pod loss. Causality critic claims no pod breaks and recommends changing a timer. Novice cannot explain damage without weapon fire. Information critic misses both part events.
rows.confusion: A real target-part event is audible but its action and state change are not legible. The timer diagnosis is wrong and must not become an implementation ticket.
rows.minimal_fix: Make the existing Writ→specific pod loss→core opening chain readable; reduce competing bloom/banter before adding VFX.

rows.ground_truth: lifeLost at 1.466 s (2 left), 3.486 s (1 left), 5.501 s (0 left). scanLock/codex near 4.035 s and 5.319 s. Graze praise starts 1.30 s; lock praise starts 3.91 s.
rows.accounts: Information critic infers one-hit instant death. Causality critic says no visible health indicator. Novice rates causal clarity 5 but describes an underspecified damage sequence. All miss the full three-loss sequence.
rows.confusion: Hull exists in DOM and small top-right cells, but is not attended/read. Positive praise competes with actual damage and continues into failure presentation.
rows.minimal_fix: Protect readable hull state from install UI; give damage priority and cancel stale praise. No extra decorative impact effect first.

rows.ground_truth: At fatal hit, subtitle and codex toast remain visible over GAME OVER. Earlier opening narration sources overlap. No visible radio box is present at the fatal hit.
rows.accounts: Observers identify the game-over modal, but disagree about number of hits and whether scanning/fire caused the outcome.
rows.confusion: Partial overlap coverage only: hit + speech/subtitle + codex + HUD is captured, not the requested simultaneous radio-box case.
rows.minimal_fix: Clear/defer nonurgent UI on fatal state; schedule a separate real-input full radio-overlap replication before claiming complete coverage.

rows.ground_truth: Mouse selects Sensor package; inspector updates to Auditor. Lock time reduction is cyan/green, not a red penalty.
rows.accounts: All three find the calm menu readable. Novice wrongly claims the beneficial lock-time delta is red; other passes correctly describe it as beneficial cyan/green.
rows.confusion: An isolated judge color error, not evidence to reverse the existing comparison semantics.
rows.minimal_fix: Preserve the working calm hierarchy. Do not implement the novice's false color correction.

rows.ground_truth: Wrong ArrowRight input occurs at 4.025 s. Corrective subtitle appears, but QA finds zero audible VO in its 4.035–7.425 s window; no corrective VO source starts.
rows.accounts: Novice and causality passes claim to hear the exact correction. Audio-only omits it. Information critic infers reactive feedback but does not list it as heard.
rows.confusion: Demonstrated subtitle-to-hearing leakage. Combined G audio-intelligibility ratings of 5 cannot certify the correction.
rows.minimal_fix: Label correction as text-only or render its VO deliberately; preserve this canary in future judge runs.

rows.ground_truth: Shift held before the focus lesson at clip 25.689 s; released at 46.037 s; fresh Shift press at 47.870 s; tut.focused only becomes true after fresh input. No fire input is sent at any time.
rows.accounts: Combined passes explain focus from narration but not release/repress. Picture-only says focus state cannot be verified. Information critic hallucinates bullets at 52–57 s; other passes correctly report no firing.
rows.confusion: Narration can stand in for action evidence. The visible tutorial does not communicate binding/freshness. Intentional no-fire tail is not proof of a player stuck by controls.
rows.minimal_fix: One binding-aware current-step prompt and visible focus state with less bloom; do not infer an actual firing/control defect from this scripted idle tail.

rows.ground_truth: Full 390×844 browser viewport, not a crop. Selection changes in the hangar list, while inspector and bottom control legend are outside the visible frame.
rows.accounts: All three can read the list but cannot see what the selection changes. They call it a possible crop; causality drops to 2/5.
rows.confusion: Legible text does not imply usable information architecture. This is a layout gap, not evidence of mobile gameplay controls.
rows.minimal_fix: Stack or explicitly reveal the selected-item inspector and visible Back affordance within the narrow viewport.
